contrary_evidence: USGS Brazil reserve estimates do not imply commercial production, and ANM concentrate statistics use a different product and classification.
Foreign ownership or contracts do not constitute evidence of intended armed invasion.
Albania is not a comparable rare-earth reserve power; Argentina's identified resources have different classification.
Protection of the Amazon and protected lands can be legitimate sovereign decisions independent of extraction.
